description: This file defines the 'LineTypes' class which is a snippet for illustrating various line drawing methods using the PdfSharp library, such as DrawLine, DrawLines, DrawBezier, DrawBeziers, DrawCurve, and DrawArc, within a PDF graphics context.

classes.name: LineTypes
classes.description: A snippet class demonstrating various line drawing methods on a PDF graphics context.
